api.title: Connect VidGrab to your own system (API)
api.intro: Download videos automatically from your app or server, with two tiers: personal and business.

personal.title: Personal API key
personal.body: For developers and small needs. On the Pro or Team plan, create an API key yourself on the API Keys page, then call <c1>POST /api/v1/fetch-link</c1> with the header <c2>X-API-Key: vidgrab_…</c2>. The request stays open until the download finishes, then returns the result. Limit of 30 requests per minute per key, and a monthly request total that depends on your plan.

partner.title: Partner API for businesses
partner.body: For businesses calling from their own servers: create background download jobs and receive results through signed webhooks. Limits are set per key (jobs per minute and per day), with a monthly job quota set by contract. A key can be restricted to your server's IP. Keys that look like <c1>vgp_…</c1> are issued by VidGrab; you cannot create them yourself.
